name: Inshore
alt: Two anglers holding redfish by the mangroves
line: Watch a redfish push up along the mangrove roots, then make the cast. Protected water and short runs, with snook and trout in the same places.

name: Nearshore
alt: Angler holding a sheepshead caught nearshore
line: A short run past the beaches, then snapper, grouper and sheepshead coming up off the reef, with kingfish passing through in spring and fall.

name: Offshore
alt: Snapper and grouper laid out on the deck after an offshore trip
line: Drop to Gulf wrecks and ledges 40 to 100 feet down and feel a grouper try to take it back to the bottom.

name: Crappie
alt: A cooler lid covered in crappie from Lake Kissimmee
line: Quiet lake water near Orlando, and a school of specks that keeps biting once you find it.

name: Redfish
alt: Guest holding a redfish in front of the mangroves
line: Your first red or a bigger one, on the flats and oyster bars.

name: Snook
alt: Guest holding a snook in front of the mangroves
line: Mangrove edges, docks and passes. Catch and release all year, with harvest windows in spring and fall.

name: Tarpon
alt: Charter boat tied up at the dock on Tampa Bay
line: The summer run, May through July, on the bridges and passes.

name: Grouper
alt: Angler holding a grouper on Tampa Bay
line: Gag and red grouper, timed to the season.

name: Shark
alt: Guest kneeling beside a shark brought up to the boat
line: Bull sharks, blacktips, hammerheads and nurse sharks on heavy tackle.
